MedicalTherapyCycleMention.description: A named or numbered chemotherapy cycle (for protocols that use cycles).

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

phase.description: Documented induction, consolidation or salvage phase.

protocol_name_verbatim.description: Protocol linking this cycle to its regimen if stated.
protocol_name_verbatim.title: Protocol Name Verbatim

completion_status.description: Explicit planned, started, completed, interrupted or discontinued cycle status.
completion_status.title: Completion Status

interruption_reason.description: Reason for interruption/discontinuation only if stated; do not infer toxicity or progression.
interruption_reason.title: Interruption Reason

cycle_name.description: Cycle name or number as written (e.g. 'Induction Cycle 2', 'Cycle 3'). Null if none.
cycle_name.title: Cycle Name

cycle_start_date.description: Cycle start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
cycle_start_date.title: Cycle Start Date

cycle_start_date_precision.description: Precision for cycle_start_date. Null when it is null.

cycle_stop_date.description: Cycle stop date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
cycle_stop_date.title: Cycle Stop Date

cycle_stop_date_precision.description: Precision for cycle_stop_date. Null when it is null.

MedicalTherapyRegimenMention.description:
A medical-therapy (chemotherapy) regimen: the protocol the patient is treated on or
in accordance with, its start/stop, and the agents it comprises. Emit one per distinct
regimen documented in this note.

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

documented_trial_arm.description: Explicit randomized arm assignment, if any. Do not infer randomization from observed treatment.
documented_trial_arm.title: Documented Trial Arm

protocol_name_verbatim.description: Treatment protocol name as written (e.g. 'ACNS0334', 'CCG99703', 'Head Start'). Null if the note states the patient is not treated per a protocol, or no protocol is named.
protocol_name_verbatim.title: Protocol Name Verbatim

regimen_start_date.description: Regimen start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
regimen_start_date.title: Regimen Start Date

regimen_start_date_precision.description: Precision for regimen_start_date. Null when it is null.

regimen_stop_date.description: Regimen stop date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
regimen_stop_date.title: Regimen Stop Date

regimen_stop_date_precision.description: Precision for regimen_stop_date. Null when it is null.

agents.description: Agents documented for this regimen; inspect delivery_status to establish receipt, not the protocol name.
agents.title: Agents

MedicalTherapyRegimenMention.title: MedicalTherapyRegimenMention

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

infusion_date.description: Actual stem-cell infusion date, not collection date.
infusion_date.title: Infusion Date

infusion_date_precision.description: Precision for infusion_date; null if absent.

cycle_name.description: Associated consolidation cycle, only when documented.
cycle_name.title: Cycle Name

cell_source.description: Autologous peripheral blood, bone marrow or other documented source.
cell_source.title: Cell Source

cd34_cells_per_kg.description: Explicit absolute CD34+ cells/kg; convert a stated multiplier such as 2 x 10^6 to 2000000. Never substitute collected dose for infused dose.
cd34_cells_per_kg.title: Cd34 Cells Per Kg

TherapyAdministrationMention.description: One documented administration or protocol dose for an agent.

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

delivery_status.description: ADMINISTERED requires actual receipt. Planned protocol doses, held doses and cancelled orders remain separate.

phase.description: Documented phase of this dose; never infer from drug name alone.

cycle_name.description: Cycle linked to this administration, if stated.
cycle_name.title: Cycle Name

administration_date.description: Administration date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
administration_date.title: Administration Date

administration_date_precision.description: Precision for administration_date. Null when it is null.

dose_amount.description: Numeric dose amount as documented. Use the per-body-surface-area amount when the note gives g/m2 or mg/m2; otherwise use the administered amount. Null if no numeric dose is stated.
dose_amount.title: Dose Amount

dose_unit.description: Dose unit exactly as written, including denominator when present, such as 'g/m2', 'mg/m2', or 'mg/kg'. Null when dose_amount is null.
dose_unit.title: Dose Unit

route.description: Administration route as written, such as intravenous, intrathecal, or oral. Null if not stated.
route.title: Route

high_dose_methotrexate_explicit_bool.description: True only when this administration is explicitly called high-dose methotrexate. False only when explicitly characterized as not high-dose; null when unknown. Numeric dose-based classification occurs downstream. This label does not establish receipt; inspect delivery_status.
high_dose_methotrexate_explicit_bool.title: High Dose Methotrexate Explicit Bool

TherapyAdministrationMention.title: TherapyAdministrationMention

TherapyAgentMention.description:
A single systemic agent documented in treatment planning or delivery. Emit one per distinct
agent (e.g. vincristine, cisplatin, cyclophosphamide, methotrexate).

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

delivery_status.description: Receipt of this agent when individual doses are not detailed. Plans do not establish exposure.

agent_name.description: Therapeutic agent name as written (generic preferred). Null if none documented.
agent_name.title: Agent Name

therapy_start_date.description: Agent start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
therapy_start_date.title: Therapy Start Date

therapy_start_date_precision.description: Precision for therapy_start_date. Null when it is null.

therapy_stop_date.description: Agent stop date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
therapy_stop_date.title: Therapy Stop Date

therapy_stop_date_precision.description: Precision for therapy_stop_date. Null when it is null.

administrations.description: All distinct dated administrations or explicitly stated protocol doses for this agent in the document. Empty when no administration-level detail is stated.
administrations.title: Administrations

stem_cell_infusions.description: Documented stem-cell rescue/infusion events, separate from collection and plans.

cycles.description: All named/numbered therapy cycles documented in this note; empty list if none.
cycles.title: Cycles
